scriptContent.title: The Quiet Relay
scriptContent.logline: Two field engineers preserve a failing beacon through deliberate, traceable actions.
scriptContent.synopsis: Ari and Mina stabilize an isolated relay, cross a marked service lane, and record its recovery.

scenes.heading: Relay Garden - Control Deck
scenes.action: Ari steadies the relay housing while Mina seats the final connector and the status glyph illuminates.

dialogue.speaker: Mina Sol
dialogue.text: The relay is stable; hold this position.

narration: The garden answers with a low electrical hum.
scenes.scenePurpose: Establish the repair and its deterministic visual confirmation.
productionNotes: Neutral daylight and a fixed control deck.

scenes.heading: Relay Garden - Service Lane
scenes.action: Ari walks the marked lane while Mina observes the steady beacon from the control deck.
scenes.scenePurpose: Confirm stable operation after the repair.
continuityNotes: The lane markers and beacon state remain unchanged.

worldRules.statement: A relay state is trusted only when its recorded indicator is stable.

glossaryTerms.definition: A deterministic indicator rendered from relay telemetry.

timelineEvents.summary: The relay returns to a stable state.

visualConstraints.rule: The active status glyph is amber and spatially fixed.

prohibitedNarrativePatterns.rule: A recovered relay must retain a traceable indicator record.

characters.name: Ari Vale
characters.background: A field engineer responsible for relay mechanics.
characters.motivation: Restore the relay without losing evidence.
characters.belief: A repair is complete only when it can be verified.
characters.conflict: The relay housing is unstable during the repair.
characters.goal: Hold the housing and verify the recovered state.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not claim an unverified repair.
visualIdentityRules: Blue field jacket and silver tool band.

characters.name: Mina Sol
characters.background: A systems engineer responsible for relay telemetry.
characters.conflict: The final connector must be seated while the housing moves.
characters.goal: Seat the connector and confirm the status glyph.
behaviorRules: Confirm the indicator before releasing the housing.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not bypass the telemetry record.
visualIdentityRules: Gray field jacket and amber wrist display.
